title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-2026-03-24-draft
content:
SRE Weekly Ops Sync — prep notes (2026-03-24)
Owner: Samira Patel
Attendees (prep): Jordan Lee, Aisha Khan, Mateo Rivera, Samira
Oncall this week: Jordan Lee (primary), Aisha Khan (secondary)

Agenda (30m)
- Quick SLO snapshot (5m)
- Paging trends & noise review (7m)
- Top incidents + mitigations (10m)
- Runbook / monitoring gaps (5m)
- Action items & owners (3m)

SLO snapshot (last 7 days)
- API latency SLO (p95 < 300ms): 96.2% (target 99.5%) — breach windows on 3/20 and 3/22 during large batch jobs.
- Availability SLO (error rate < 0.1%): 99.86% (target 99.95%) — two short spikes associated with model-fallback loop.
- Embeddings throughput SLO: 98.9% (target 99.0%) — borderline due to autoscaler lag.

Notes: need a short-term mitigation to avoid repeated p95 bursts (see action item AI-1). Longer-term: investigate kernel scheduling for batch jobs (infra ticket JIRA-4821).

Paging trends
- Pages triggered: 18 total (up from 11 prior week).
  - Noise from infra-agent alerts (6) related to ephemeral node churn; root cause: kubelet restart cascade after node patching.
  - Application error pages (7) primarily from model-fallback loop hitting deprecated model variant; causes 500s.
  - True-severity incidents (5): 2 high, 3 medium.
- Average time-to-ack: 4m (target < 5m) — good.
- Average time-to-resolve on true incidents: 35m (target < 30m) — slightly high due to debug time on model-fallback.

Actionable observations:
- Noise source: ephemeral node churn alerts need throttling and better dedupe in PagerDuty. (Owner: Mateo)
- Model-fallback loop is surfacing as a repeated source of 500s; appears to be caused by version mismatch between routing policy and model variants (see JIRA-4799). Need immediate guardrail to stop repeated fallbacks. (Owner: Jordan)
- Autoscaler lag for embeddings path — increase scale-up aggressiveness for embeddings queue length > 500 for next 48h experiment. (Owner: Aisha)

Top incidents (last 7 days)
1) 2026-03-20 02:14 UTC — p95 latency breach (duration ~25m)
   - Summary: Large simultaneous batch ingestion increased KV cache misses and caused CPU contention on inference hosts.
   - Mitigation: Manually scaled dedicated pool and bumped batch limiter; rolled back heavy batch ingestion.
   - Postmortem POC: draft started (linked JIRA-4821).
   - Action: add pre-batch admission control at API gateway for large batch requests (Owner: Samira, due 2026-04-02).

2) 2026-03-22 14:05 UTC — repeated 500s from model fallback (duration ~18m)
   - Summary: Auto-routing to small-quantized variant failed due to missing compatibility mapping in routing table; fallback loop repeatedly retried.
   - Mitigation: Temporarily disabled automatic fallback to quantized variant and re-routed traffic to stable hosted variant.
   - Action: fix routing mapping and add circuit breaker to limit fallback retries (Owner: Jordan, due 2026-03-31).

3) 2026-03-21 09:40 UTC — embeddings throughput degradation (duration ~40m)
   - Summary: Autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes quickly enough due to conservative cooldowns.
   - Mitigation: Manual scale-up + adjusted scale policy (short term).
   - Action: change cooldown and test in staging (Owner: Aisha, due 2026-03-28).

Runbook / monitoring gaps
- No clear runbook for model-fallback loop; existing doc assumes single fallback but not loop/flood conditions. Add explicit circuit breaker guidance and detection rules. (Owner: Samira; Confluence page to update: /spaces/SRE/pages/37122/SLO-runbook)
- Alert dedupe for node churn is noisy — need to tune the infra-agent and add correlation keys to reduce pages. (Owner: Mateo)
- Missing synthetic test for embeddings latency distribution under burst load. Add a synthetic job in observability playbook. (Owner: Aisha)

Open action items (concrete)
- AI-1: Short-term p95 mitigation: enforce per-account batch concurrency limit at gateway. Owner: Samira. Due: 2026-04-02. Linked: JIRA-4821.
- AI-2: Circuit breaker for fallback retries + routing mapping fix. Owner: Jordan. Due: 2026-03-31. Linked: JIRA-4799.
- AI-3: Autoscaler cooldown change + staging test for embeddings. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-28.
- AI-4: Alert dedupe & correlation keys for node-churn alerts. Owner: Mateo. Due: 2026-03-30.
- AI-5: Create synthetic embedding latency test job and add to daily monitoring. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-29.

Notes to self / prep reminders
- Bring the SLO trend chart for p95 (last 30 days) to the sync — visual helps show regression. (Samira)
- Ask Jordan to demo the temporary fallback disablement flow so we can document it in runbook. (Samira)
- Confirm with infra about planned maintenance windows that might have caused node patch-related churn (Mateo to follow up).

Follow-ups (after meeting)
- Share condensed incident summaries with product & support (Samira) — include customer impact and mitigation timeline.
- Schedule postmortem review session for JIRA-4821 (owner: Samira).
- Roll plan for autoscaler tuning to non-prod staging first, then prod with canary. (Owner: Aisha)

Backlog items (for triage)
- Investigate KV cache eviction tuning for large-batch workloads. (low pri)
- Evaluate model variant compatibility checks as part of model onboarding flow. (medium pri)

Misc / brainstorm
- Consider a lightweight circuit-breaker-as-a-service in routing layer that teams can opt into — simple token bucket to bound retries from fallback behavior. Could reduce repeated 500 loops across multiple services. (Idea, bring to platform roadmap)

Meeting prep checklist
- Attach SLO charts + incident timelines to calendar invite.
- Add action items to team board and assign owners before EOD.
- Print quick runbook excerpt for model-fallback to share during sync.

End of notes.
